title: BACK OF HOUSE / FRONT OF TIDE
style:
Extended Coastal Electro Anthem — 124 BPM

STYLE TAGS
124 BPM four-on-the-floor,
deep rolling sub-bass,
clean coastal synth plucks,
progressive build,
male spoken breakdown,
anthemic layered chorus,
WA ocean energy,
extended festival drop sections
lyrics:
[INTRO — LOW FILTERED KICK + DISTANT ENGINE HUM]

While the ocean moves,
Someone keeps it moving.

Two boats ready.
One coastline breathing.

[VERSE 1]

Anna’s lights on before the sun
Bookings stacked, not one undone
Schedules tight and manifests clear
Every detail engineered

Kristen mapping every frame
Camera grids labelled by name
Electrical lines run clean and tight
Monitoring both boats through the night

Zack with patterns on his screen
Reads the crowd before it’s seen
Data curves like open tide
Forecast strong, systems aligned

[PRE-CHORUS — BUILD RISING]

Hard to let it go
When you built it from the ground
Hard to step back slow
When your fingerprints are found

But trust is not surrender
It’s expansion in disguise
When the crew you trained
Now rise

[CHORUS — FULL ANTHEM]

Front of tide
Back of house
Every role
Every ounce

Live Wire running
Pelican strong
Ocean pulse
All night long

From the bridge
To the bow
Every system
Working now

[DROP 1 — EXTENDED GROOVE]

Anna steady
Kristen strong
Zack aligning
All night long

Tom and Tay
Deckhand flow
Lines pulled tight
Engines go

Alfie lifting
Crowd ignite
Captain Pete
Reads the night

Captain Brandon
Holds the line
Indian Ocean
Every time

[VERSE 2 — MORE DRIVE]

Hard to delegate the flame
When it carries your own name
Built from weld sparks and risk
Signed your life across the list

Live Wire sharp in open blue
Pelican steady pushing through
Steel frame grounded, hull runs clean
Western coast in every scene

Bridge above and deck below
Ocean strength is how they grow
Trust the crew and let it run
That’s how legacy is done

[PRE-CHORUS — CALL & RESPONSE]

Who runs deck? — Tom and Tay
Who lifts vibe? — Alfie, aye
Who reads tide? — Pete and Brandon
Who keeps watch? — Kristen standing

Who keeps books and lines complete? — Anna
Who tracks patterns in the heat? — Zack

[DROP 2 — BIGGER, WIDER]

Two boats
One coast
One crew
WA truth

Front of tide
Back of house
Salt and bass
Shaking south

Live Wire
Pelican
Side by side
Run again

Indian Ocean
Under feet
Western coast
On repeat

[BREAKDOWN — HALF-TIME SPOKEN]

You don’t lose control
When you trust your crew.

You multiply it.

You don’t give it away.
You let it grow.

Two boats don’t move
Because one man holds the wheel.

They move
Because every role is real.

[FINAL BUILD — LONG FESTIVAL RISE]

Lights flash blue
Wind cuts clean
Salt in air
Engines lean

Hands on rail
Deck alive
Ocean breath
Overdrive

Rise
Rise
Rise

[FINAL DROP — FULL EXTENDED CLOSER]

Front of tide
Back of house
Live Wire pulse
Pelican south

Anna steady
Kristen clear
Zack forecasting
Through the year

Tom and Tay
Hold the line
Alfie lighting
Party time

Captain Pete
Calm and strong
Captain Brandon
All night long

Two boats
One spine
Western coast
Defined

Indian Ocean
Every time

[OUTRO — ENGINE HUM + PAD FADE]

Throttle down.
Deck lights dim.
Ocean steady.

Tomorrow —
Again.
